title: Add translations for ProductMedia alt text
author: EugenBodanov
body_preview: ### Problem  Saleor supports translations for many catalog fields, including product names, descriptions, SEO fields, categories, collections, attributes, attribute values, and variants. title: Bug: account can be reactivated using accountConfirm mutation
author: NyanKiyoshi
body_preview: Someone having a valid token for `accountConfirm()` can re-activate their account when a staff user sets it to `is_active=False`. For example, when offboarding former employees, a staff user may set `is_active=False` but can then be switched back to `is_active=True` by running `accountConfirm()`.  The mutation should be changed so it no longer flips the `is_active` flag.

title: Drop support for HS256 JWTs
author: NyanKiyoshi
body_preview: Saleor currently supports JWT signing using HS256 which uses `SECRET_KEY`.
